commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== rewrite script =="
cat > /tmp/inventory-maintenance.new <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
SCRIPT
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/inventory-maintenance.new /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
rm -f /tmp/inventory-maintenance.new

echo "== verify script =="
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
stat -c '%a %U:%G' /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== test run =="
/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== ensure log file exists with sane perms =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
sudo -n chown root:root /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
sudo -n chmod 0644 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log

echo "== install cron job for root =="
CRON_LINE="15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1"
( sudo -n crontab -l -u root 2>/dev/null | grep -vF 'inventory-maintenance' || true; echo "$CRON_LINE" ) | sudo -n crontab -u root -

echo "== verify cron installed =="
sudo -n crontab -l -u root

echo "== verify crond active =="
systemctl is-active crond
